title: List filtering preserves exactly matching members
summary: An element belongs to a filtered Lean list exactly when it belongs to the input and the Boolean predicate holds. Useful for membership and input-origin arguments.

source.statement: x ∈ List.filter p as ↔ x ∈ as ∧ p x

assumptions: p : α → Bool; as : List α; x : α. The predicate result is coerced from Bool to a proposition.
reuse: With leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0, import Init.Data.List.Lemmas and use List.mem_filter to rewrite filtered-list membership into input membership and the predicate.
